item.title: Mauritius Open: Sharma Lies 42nd; Jarvis And Gerard Lead
item.description: DP World Tour: Shubhankar Sharma’s third round at the Mauritius Open at the demanding La Réserve Links, produced an eventful card featuring two eagles amid relentless wind and intermittent rain.

item.title: 'Nice To Be Sitting 3 Nil Up': Labuschagne After Australia Retain Ashes With 3-0 Lead
item.description: Cricket Australia: While there was a brief moment of doubt, Australia have once again retained the Ashes urn with a dominant victory, beating England by 82 runs in the third Test at the Adelaide Oval. Following the win, Marnus Labuschagne quipped that it was satisfying to secure the series after being called the ‘worst Australian team in 15 years’ before the Ashes started.

item.title: 80th CCI Western India Squash: Top Seeds Chotrani, Joshna Enter Semis
item.description: CCI Western India: The 80th CCI Western India squash tournament moved into its decisive phase on Saturday as the semi-finals delivered high-quality squash, intense rallies, and moments of sheer grit, underlining why this championship remains one of the most prestigious events on the domestic squash calendar.

item.title: Ashes: Cummins, Starc And Lyon Star As Australia Win Adelaide Test; Retain Title
item.description: Boxing Day Test: Mitchell Starc, skipper Pat Cummins, and Nathan Lyon shared nine wickets as Australia stormed to an 82-run victory in the Adelaide Test, retaining the Ashes series after winning their third consecutive Test this series.

item.title: La Liga: Real Madrid Takes Controversial Win Against Sevilla
item.description: Carlos Tartiere Stadium: Real Madrid moved to within a point of FC Barcelona at the top of La Liga with a controversial 2-0 home win over Sevilla on Saturday.

item.title: World Cup-winning Indian Blind Women’s Team Visits BCCI Headquarters
item.description: Honorary Joint Secretary Prabhtej Singh: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) felicitated the Indian blind women’s cricket team following their triumphant campaign in the inaugural Women’s T20 World Cup for the Blind.

item.title: Premier League: Arsenal Top For Christmas After Narrow Win, Haaland Keeps Pressure On
item.description: West Ham United: Arsenal will be top of the Premier League at Christmas thanks to a hard-fought 1-0 win away to Everton on Saturday.

item.title: Ben Stokes Says Losing Ashes in 11 Days Sucks but Vows England Will Bounce Back
item.description: England captain Ben Stokes admitted it “sucks” to lose the Ashes inside 11 days but promised a stronger and more consistent comeback in the final two Tests, praising England’s improved fight in Adelaide despite Australia’s dominance.

item.title: Bundesliga: Leverkusen Rallies To Beat Leipzig 3-1
item.description: Substitute Montrell Culbreath: Bayer Leverkusen ended the Bundesliga year with an away win on Saturday, coming from behind to beat RB Leipzig 3-1 and climb to third place in the table.

item.title: Desert Vipers Ease Past Sharjah Warriorz by Four Wickets to Seal Top-Two Spot in ILT20 Season 4
item.description: Desert Vipers defeated Sharjah Warriorz by four wickets in ILT20 Season 4, chasing 90 with ease to secure a top-two spot as David Payne’s brilliant spell and Sam Curran’s composed 37 guided a dominant win.
